protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; cancer outside the nasal cavity remains unaddressed in saved criteria.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The ulcerative-colitis study expressly excludes malignancy within five years except named epithelial cancers; EMC is outside those exceptions.
cohort_reconciliation: Afimkibart and placebo induction regimens share the malignancy restriction; no cancer-treatment cohort.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed. Remote disease-free history is not adjudicated for any individual; this label retains the five-year condition.
quotes: History of malignancy within 5 years, with the exception of malignancies adequately treated with resection for non-metastatic basal cell or squamous cell cancer or in situ cervical cancer

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: Crohn's protocol excludes cancer history with less than five years disease-free except specified epithelial cancers; this restricts active/recent EMC scope.
cohort_reconciliation: Study 1 induction/maintenance, Study 2 induction, placebo and extensions all share Crohn's entry. Extensions require completion and protocol prerequisites; no new oncology basket.
protocol_uncertainty: Criteria are explicitly non-exhaustive; external protocol unreviewed. Five-year disease-free condition must not become exclusion of every remote cancer history.
